tools.name: check_ssl
tools.description: Check a host's TLS/SSL certificate: issuer, validity dates, expiry, chain and trust verdict.

tools.name: check_dns
tools.description: Check a domain's DNS records (A/AAAA/CNAME/TXT/NS and more).

tools.name: dns_propagation
tools.description: Check DNS propagation of a domain across multiple public resolvers.

tools.name: mx_lookup
tools.description: MX lookup for a domain: its mail exchanger records and their addresses.

tools.name: spf_check
tools.description: Check a domain's SPF record: fetch it and evaluate the policy.

tools.name: dkim_check
tools.description: Check a domain's DKIM public key for a given selector: fetch it and validate it.

tools.name: dmarc_check
tools.description: Check a domain's DMARC policy record: fetch it and evaluate the policy.

tools.name: dnsbl_check
tools.description: DNSBL check: whether a public IP address is listed on common DNS blacklists.

tools.name: whois
tools.description: Retrieve WHOIS registration data for a domain.

tools.name: domain_expiry
tools.description: Check a domain's registration expiry date and the days remaining.

tools.name: http_headers
tools.description: Fetch the HTTP response headers for a URL.

tools.name: hsts_check
tools.description: HSTS check: a domain's HTTP Strict Transport Security configuration.

tools.name: redirect_check
tools.description: Check the HTTP redirect chain for a URL, tracing it to the final destination.

tools.name: port_check
tools.description: Check whether a TCP port is open on a host.

tools.name: ping_test
tools.description: Ping test: measure TCP reachability and round-trip time to a host.

tools.name: website_status
tools.description: Check whether a website is up, its HTTP status and response timing.

tools.name: response_time
tools.description: Measure a website's response time (DNS, connect, TTFB, total).

tools.name: ip_geolocation
tools.description: IP geolocation for a public IP address or a domain (country, region, ASN, org).

tools.name: asn_lookup
tools.description: ASN lookup for a public IP or domain: the autonomous system and its network owner.

tools.name: reverse_dns
tools.description: Reverse DNS: resolve a public IP address to its PTR hostname.

tools.name: list_monitors
tools.description: List the website monitors the caller's API token can see (customer token: its own customer; organization token: all customers in the org). Read-only.

tools.name: monitor_status
tools.description: Get a single website monitor by id, including its current up/down status and configuration.

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.description: List recent incidents across all of the caller's monitors (most recent first).

tools.name: check_history
tools.description: Get the recent check history for a website monitor. Optionally bound by an ISO date range.

tools.name: uptime_summary
tools.description: Get uptime and average response-time summary (day / month / year) for a website monitor.
